name: AI and Automation
new_description: "description": "Dive into the fascinating world of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation. Explore the inner workings of intelligent systems that can learn, perceive, and make decisions on their own. Discover how machines can mimic human cognitive functions, from recognizing patterns in data to generating human-like language. Examine cutting-edge techniques like machine learning, neural networks, and natural language processing that enable computers to tackle complex problems. Understand the engineering principles and design considerations that go into creating self-driving cars, intelligent assistants, and other autonomous systems. This field offers a glimpse into the future, where technology and intelligence seamlessly converge.",

name: Astronomy
new_description: Explore the wonders of the cosmos! Astronomy is the study of celestial objects like stars, planets, and galaxies, as well as the principles that govern the universe. Delve into the mysteries of black holes, the formation of planetary systems, and the expansion of the universe. Uncover the origins of the cosmos, from the Big Bang to the evolution of stars and the search for habitable worlds beyond Earth.
focus_areas: stars and stellar evolution, planetary systems and exoplanets, galaxies and galactic structure, cosmology and the Big Bang theory, space exploration and the search for life

name: Biology
new_description: Unravel the mysteries of living organisms, from the microscopic workings of cells to the intricate interactions within ecosystems. Explore the fundamental principles that govern life, delving into the mechanics of genetic inheritance, the chemical processes that power our bodies, and the dynamic adaptations that allow species to thrive in diverse environments.
focus_areas: cellular biology, genetics and heredity, evolutionary theory, ecology and ecosystems

name: Business Strategy & Analysis
new_description: Delve into the captivating world of business strategy and analysis, where you'll explore the essential principles that guide successful companies. Discover how organizations make critical decisions, leverage market insights, and navigate the ever-evolving economic landscape. From understanding competitive dynamics to evaluating financial performance, this subject equips you with the tools to think like a strategic leader and drive impactful change.
focus_areas: competitive analysis, financial modeling, market trends, organizational structure, decision-making frameworks

name: Business and Economics
new_description: Dive into the fascinating world of business and economics, where you'll explore the inner workings of markets, the dynamics of supply and demand, and the strategies that drive successful organizations. Delve into topics like consumer behavior, marketing principles, financial management, and the impact of global trade and policy on economies. Discover how businesses make decisions, how money and banking systems function, and how economic indicators shape the broader landscape. With a focus on conceptual understanding, you'll gain the knowledge to navigate the ever-evolving business landscape and make informed choices.
focus_areas: consumer behavior, marketing strategies, financial decision-making, international trade and policy, economic indicators and trends
